actualError: BeanCreationException: cpfOnlineTransactionBeanPostProcessor could not be CGLIB proxied because CpfOnlineTransactionBeanPostProcessor is final
rootCause: CpfCapabilityUsageAspect matches every public com.cpf method except com.cpf.starter.runtime. It therefore treats Spring BeanPostProcessor infrastructure as a business capability consumer. Spring attempts a class proxy before startup and fails on the intentionally final infrastructure class.
impact: Fresh Generated Online Runtime cannot start although Java 25 compile/test succeeds
all applications combining the default base Starter capability aspect with Web runtime BeanPostProcessors are potentially affected
compile-only and context-light tests can falsely pass
requiredFix: exclude the standard BeanPostProcessor type hierarchy at the capability aspect pointcut owner
add an exact pointcut regression for final infrastructure and a normal CPF consumer
rerun targeted tests and the same Fresh bootJar runtime command
falseFixesProhibited: removing final only to permit an invalid proxy
disabling AOP or the capability feature
